text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to allow on-street parking during the off-peak periods on both sides of Wilson Heights Boulevard between Sheppard Avenue West and Reiner Road. The existing stopping prohibition that is in effect at all times will be rescinded and replaced with a parking prohibition that will be in effect between the hours of 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. The parking amendments are feasible and will provide on-street parking opportunities for the local residents and businesses located on the subject section of Wilson Heights Boulevard, as their parking demand can exceed the capacity of their on-site parking. North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing stopping prohibitions in effect at all times on the east side of Wilson Heights Boulevard between Reiner Road and a point 148 metres north, and between a point 154 metres north of Reiner Road and Sheppard Avenue West. 2. Rescinded the existing stopping prohibition in effect at all times on the west side of Wilson Heights Boulevard between Reiner Road and Sheppard Avenue West. 3. Prohibited parking from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on both sides of Wilson Heights Boulevard, between Sheppard Avenue West and Reiner Road.
